chosen_explanation_scope: pre-hoc: physically motivated time/spectrum/envelope feature design inherited from Problem 1
post-hoc: final RandomForest global split importance and sample-dependent decision-path importance
why_no_forced_transfer_process_explanati: STEP09 selected A0_no_transfer; A2 CORAL and A3 instance weighting were rejected. There is no promoted target transform or adapted shared representation to explain as if it were used.

faithfulness.definition: Features are ranked by local RF decision-path impurity usage; validation independently replaces the top-5 raw features by the file-balanced source median and compares output change with bottom-5 and 30 random 5-feature controls.

stability.input_perturbation: independent Gaussian noise, sd=0.500% of source independent-file feature SD

mechanism_consistency.scope: Known source representatives only for exact BPFO/BPFI validation; target geometry is unknown, so target exact characteristic-frequency validation is prohibited.
mechanism_consistency.source_B_step03_note: B007_0 was deliberately retained as a difficult/contradictory case: STEP03 BSF envelope support was false, so it is not used to manufacture a positive consistency claim.

causal_claim: prohibited; importance and ablation measure model dependence/sensitivity, not physical causation
limitations: The final target model is the frozen source RandomForest with no promoted domain adaptation; all A-P remain out-of-support/low-trust STEP10 predictions.
RandomForest impurity/path importance can favor features used repeatedly by tree splits and can distribute importance across correlated features.
Median-feature ablation creates synthetic feature combinations and tests model dependence, not a physically realizable intervention.

Source known-label representatives were used to train the final all-source model; their final-model explanations are illustrative, not held-out performance estimates. OOF predictions are reported separately.
Target bearing geometry and exact per-file speed are unavailable; source SKF6205 BPFO/BPFI/BSF frequencies are not imposed on target explanations.
A-P explanations cannot establish target ground truth or target accuracy.
